title: Cross-Lingual Information Retrieval in Tetun for Ad-Hoc Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.34362v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Developing information retrieval (IR) systems that enable access across multiple languages is crucial in multilingual contexts. In Timor-Leste, where Tetun, Portuguese, English, and Indonesian are official and working languages, no cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) solutions currently exist to support information access across these languages. This study addresses that gap by investigating CLIR approaches tailored to the linguistic landscape of Timor-Leste. Leveraging an existing monolingual Tetun document collection and ad-hoc text retrieval baselines, we explore the feasibility of CLIR for Tetun. Queries were manually translated into Portuguese, English, and Indonesian to create a multilingual query set. These were then automatically translated back into Tetun using Google Translate and several large language models, and used to retrieve documents in Tetun. Results show that Google Translate is the most reliable tool for Tetun

translated_title: 面向即席搜索的德顿语跨语言信息检索
translated_abstract: 开发能够支持多语言访问的信息检索（IR）系统在多语言环境中至关重要。在东帝汶，德顿语、葡萄牙语、英语和印尼语是官方语言和工作语言，但目前尚无跨语言信息检索（CLIR）解决方案来支持这些语言之间的信息访问。本研究通过探索针对东帝汶语言环境量身定制的CLIR方法来填补这一空白。利用现有的德顿语单语文档集合和即席文本检索基线，我们探索了德顿语CLIR的可行性。查询被人工翻译成葡萄牙语、英语和印尼语以构建多语言查询集，随后使用谷歌翻译和多个大语言模型将这些查询自动翻译回德顿语，并用于检索德顿语文档。结果表明，谷歌翻译是目前处理德顿语最可靠的翻译工具。
tldr: 本研究首次针对东帝汶多语言环境探索了德顿语跨语言信息检索的可行性，通过将葡萄牙语、英语和印尼语查询翻译回德顿语进行文档检索，发现谷歌翻译是目前德顿语最可靠的自动翻译工具。
en_tdlr: This study is the first to explore the feasibility of cross-lingual information retrieval (CLIR) for Tetun in Timor-Leste's multilingual context, retrieving documents by translating Portuguese, English, and Indonesian queries back into Tetun, and finding that Google Translate is currently the most reliable automatic translation tool for Tetun.
